name: Japa
subtitle: Hibiscus & Rose Frizz Control
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A deeply softening, botanical smoothing oil designed to restore calm and natural lustre to unruly hair. Japa blends the moisture-locking power of Hibiscus (Japa) with the soothing, delicate essence of Rose to naturalize and tame frizz. Enriched with cool, hydration-preserving Aloe Vera and nutrient-dense Jojoba, this lightweight formula seals the hair cuticle, smooths flyaways, and softens strands, leaving behind a delicate, botanical scent.

ingredients.name: Hibiscus Flowers
ingredients.role: Deeply conditions and softens, helping to prevent frizz and retain natural moisture

ingredients.name: Rose Petals
ingredients.role: Soothing and fragrant, offering natural conditioning to smooth unruly strands

ingredients.name: Aloe Leaves
ingredients.role: Provides cooling hydration and locks in natural moisture along the hair shaft

ingredients.name: Jojoba Seeds
ingredients.role: Lightweight, mimics natural sebum to smooth split ends and boost elasticity

whyThisHerb: Hibiscus is historically celebrated for its natural humectant properties, working in complete harmony with the softening, protective qualities of Rose to ease frizz and leave strands manageable and silk-soft.

howToUse.title: Dispense
howToUse.description: Pour a few drops of the floral oil into your palms and warm them together slightly to release its botanical scent.

howToUse.title: Smooth
howToUse.description: Gently work your hands through the mid-lengths to ends of damp or dry hair, focusing on frizz-prone areas.

howToUse.title: Even
howToUse.description: Gently comb through with your fingers to evenly distribute and seal the nourishing botanicals.

howToUse.title: Shine
howToUse.description: Leave in as a daily protective shield to maintain natural softness, shine, and frizz control.
